d: Shahid sobran soren ke shahadat divas samaroh men shamil hone ke lie mukhyamantri hemant soren ramgarh jile ke nemra pahunche. is mauke par mukhyamantri ne 111 karor rupye ki vibhinn vikas yojnaon ka shilanyas aur udghatan kiya tatha labhukon ke bich parisanpattiyon ka vitran kiya. vahin, jharkhand haeekort ke sevanivritt mukhy nyayadhish nyaymurti em.es. sonak ko samaroh aayojit kar vidaee di gaee. nyaymurti sujit narayan prasad ko haeekort ka naya karyavahak mukhy nyayadhish niyukt kiya gaya hai, jo kal se karyabhar sanbhalenge. idhar, ranchi men 21ven pulis dyuti mit ka shubharanbh…
